fact: The ministry states the right is governed by Law 31-13, adopted 22 February 2018 and published 12 March 2018, and that in 2025 the national portal was transferred by agreement to the Commission du droit d'accès à l'information.
title: Droit d'accès à l'information
publisher: Ministère de l'Intelligence artificielle, de la Transformation numérique et de la Réforme de l'Administration
